items.title: Attackers Harvest Dropbox Logins Via Fake PDF Lures
items.description: A malware-free phishing campaign targets corporate inboxes and asks employees to view "request orders," ultimately leading to Dropbox credential theft.

items.title: New GlassWorm attack targets macOS via compromised OpenVSX extensions
items.description: A new GlassWorm malware attack through compromised OpenVSX extensions focuses on stealing passwords, crypto-wallet data, and developer credentials and configurations from macOS systems. [...]

items.title: County Pays $600K to Wrongfully Jailed Pen Testers
items.description: Iowa police arrested two penetration testers in 2019 for doing their jobs, highlighting the risk to security professionals in red teaming exercises.

items.title: Russian hackers exploit recently patched Microsoft Office bug in attacks
items.description: Ukraine's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) says that Russian hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-21509, a recently patched vulnerability in multiple versions of Microsoft Office. [...]

items.title: Chinese Hackers Hijack Notepad++ Updates for 6 Months
items.description: State-sponsored threat actors compromised the popular code editor's hosting provider to redirect targeted users to malicious downloads.

items.title: Mozilla announces switch to disable all Firefox AI features
items.description: In response to user feedback on AI integration, Mozilla announced today that the next Firefox release will let users disable AI features entirely or manage them individually. [...]

items.title: Researchers Find 341 Malicious ClawHub Skills Stealing Data from OpenClaw Users
items.description: A security audit of 2,857 skills on ClawHub has found 341 malicious skills across multiple campaigns, according to new findings from Koi Security, exposing users to new supply chain risks. ClawHub is a marketplace designed to make it easy for OpenClaw users to find and install third-party skills. items.title: DynoWiper Data-Wiping Malware Attacking Energy Companies to Destroy Data
items.description: A dangerous new data-wiping malware known as DynoWiper has emerged, targeting energy companies in Poland with destructive attacks designed to permanently erase critical data. items.title: 30 Wind and Solar Farms in Poland Faced Coordinated Cyberattacks
items.description: On December 29, 2025, Poland faced a coordinated assault targeting more than 30 wind and solar farms, alongside a large combined heat and power plant and a manufacturing facility. items.title: OpenClaw Bug Enables One-Click Remote Code Execution via Malicious Link
items.description: A high-severity security flaw has been disclosed in OpenClaw (formerly referred to as Clawdbot and Moltbot) that could allow remote code execution (RCE) through a crafted malicious link.
